Comment.value: Concerning Pipeweed strain (roadmap: concerning-pipeweed). Smoked at the water pipes of the Smoking Chamber; all effect comes from wg_bong.nss / pw_inc.nss, so it deliberately carries no item properties.

value.0:
The finest leaf in the Southfarthing, named for Tobold Hornblower of Longbottom, who first grew the true pipe-weed in his garden. Kept in a waxed pouch and parted with reluctantly.

Smoked in a water pipe of the Smoking Chamber, old songs and older lineages come easily to mind -- and every word out of your mouth lands wrong.

Wisdom +4, Charisma -4, Lore +10, for one hour of real time. Resting will not clear it.
